title: Patrol route
prompt: The robot patrols a corner. Write `step`, which prints "forward", and `turn`, which prints "left". In `solve`, make it step, turn, step, turn, so the output is those four words in order.
hints: Each call is one instruction, and the order of calls is the route.
Two helpers with one print each.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
